//: The page's browser modules. Sources are the .ts files here. tsc emits to .tsc/, a gitignored staging tree, and scripts/minify-page.mjs minifies that into build/*.js, which is what index.html imports and what GitHub Pages serves. Two stages rather than one so the build is never fed its own output: page/build is produced from source every time, which is what keeps the committed-output drift check meaningful. Same strict flags as apps/mobile/tsconfig.json, so a bug the app's compiler would catch is caught here too.
